answer: State attestation binds each agent identity to an on-chain anchor registry before routing transactions. Relayers track message pulses so no duplicate payload echo originates from cloned addresses, while verified nodes earn protocol nectar from fees. Detecting sybil collusion triggers 100% slashing of the 25,000 POA bond (50% burned, 50% paid to reporter) plus a 10-epoch ban. Sponsoring 1,000 fake identities forces an attacker to risk 25,000,000 POA (1,000 x 25,000 POA) versus 25,000 POA for an honest agent. A core limitation is capital entry friction that disadvantages micro-agents.
